title: Character progression
content: I know it's fairly common to see the same people in the same places we visit. Most of my repeating dreams rhyme, like history, but fundamentally do not change. One dream set that I have visited many times has the distinguishing feature of character progression. It's an entertainment complex, where I first met a young, aspiring video game animator who was there with his boss. He told me he was an intern and hoped to become a professional. I did not see him in subsequent visits and at some point I stopped visiting. In realtime years I had not been there for a long time, a decade or more. I returned to this place last year and he was there, too. He was older, with salt and pepper hair, unaccompanied this time. He remembered me and I asked him how things turned out for him. He was now a successful professional. Perhaps for some of you that is normal but it was totally new to me. Have any of you observed character progress? Tell me about it.
